zh: 板式轨道—桥梁相互作用
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 板式轨道与桥梁共同受列车作用时的动力联系。
usage_overview: 在移动列车作用下的动力分析中，着重考察轨道板与桥梁通过连接界面传递作用力的过程，以及这种联系对双方振动响应的影响。

complete_examples.text: Submit your article to this journal Article views: 304 View related articles View Crossmark data Citing articles: 1 View citing articles Slab track-bridge interaction subjected to a moving train: an improved matrix formulation and truncation method Qiang Zhanga, Xuehui Zhangb and Lei Xuc, d aSchool of Civil Engineering and Architecture, Guangxi University, Nanning, Guangxi, China; bDepartment of Geoscience and Engineering, Delft University of Technology, Delft, The Netherlands; cDepartment of Railway Engineering, Central South University, Changsha, Hunan, China; dNational Engineering Laboratory for High Speed Railway Construction, Central South University, Changsha, Hunan, China ABSTRACT Modelling slab track-bridge interaction subject to a moving train usually involves solving complex high-dimensional matrix equations which is time-consuming.

Besides, by firstly clarifying the degrees of freedom vector of the rail, the track slab and the bridge girder participated in each time step, dynamic matrices characterizing the train-slab track-bridge interaction are truncated with time to reduce the matrix size.
